description.zh: “x 无限接近 a 时 f(x) 趋于 L”被写成一场博弈：对方随便给一个误差 ε > 0，你总能找到一个 δ > 0，使 x 离 a 不到 δ（但不等于 a）时 f(x) 离 L 不到 ε；找不到这样的 δ，极限就不存在。
description.en: “f(x) approaches L as x gets arbitrarily close to a” is written as a game: whatever error ε > 0 the opponent names, you can always find δ > 0 so that whenever x is within δ of a (but not equal to it), f(x) is within ε of L; if no such δ exists, the limit does not exist.

label.en: The derivative is a limit of difference quotients

reason.zh: 瞬时变化率是 h → 0 时差商 (f(a+h) − f(a))/h 的极限；页面里 x² 在 a 处 δ ≈ ε/(2a)，2a 正是那一点的斜率。
reason.en: An instantaneous rate is the limit of the difference quotient (f(a+h) − f(a))/h as h → 0; on the page, for x² at a, δ ≈ ε/(2a), and 2a is exactly the slope at that point.

label.en: Infinite sums rest on sequence limits

reason.zh: 无穷项的和定义为部分和数列的极限：按 ε–N，只要 n 足够大，部分和离 S 就不到 ε；等比级数在 |r| < 1 时收敛正是这样证出来的。
reason.en: An infinite sum is defined as the limit of its partial sums: by ε–N, for large enough n the partial sum is within ε of S; that is how a geometric series is shown to converge when |r| < 1.
